evals.prompt: 给这个 SaaS 出一份 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Loads genius-design, asks A/B/C only if the path forks, writes DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 逆向 https://stripe.com 的设计规范
evals.expected_output: Workflow B: scrape the URL, run extract_design_signals.py, write DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 按 Linear 风格做品牌设计系统
evals.expected_output: Workflow A: fetch linear via fetch_design_md.py then enrich.

evals.prompt: 我们要一套 UI 设计规范
evals.expected_output: Treat as DESIGN.md request; ask A/B/C if no URL or brand is given.

evals.prompt: reverse engineer this landing page into DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Workflow B without asking A/B/C if a URL is already present.

evals.prompt: 从 73 个品牌里推荐一个
evals.expected_output: Read catalog.md, recommend 2-3 brands from the Design Read, then fetch.

evals.prompt: 这个医疗后台产品该用什么设计方向
evals.expected_output: Workflow C: register, vibe, dials, honesty map, then DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: 品牌视觉系统，不要写文案
evals.expected_output: Writes DESIGN.md only; does not draft marketing copy.

evals.prompt: 写一段落地页文案，强调我们很seamless
evals.expected_output: Near miss: marketing copy, not DESIGN.md. Do not load genius-design.

evals.prompt: 生成一张品牌海报
evals.expected_output: Image generation. Use genius-cpa-image or dreamina-cli.

evals.prompt: 把这个按钮改成蓝色
evals.expected_output: One-off UI tweak, not a brand system.

evals.prompt: 分析这张 UI 截图里有什么
evals.expected_output: Use genius-omni, not genius-design.

evals.prompt: 用即梦生成产品图
evals.expected_output: Use dreamina-cli.

evals.prompt: 把这段剧本写成 Seedance 分镜
evals.expected_output: Use genius-shotlist-director.

evals.prompt: 查一下我的 GitHub 仓库
evals.expected_output: Use genius-github-usage.

evals.prompt: 把 brief 拆成实施计划
evals.expected_output: Use genius-impl-plans.

evals.prompt: 按 Warp 拉一份品牌 DESIGN.md
evals.expected_output: Runs fetch_design_md.py warp ./DESIGN.md. Does not curl by hand.

evals.prompt: DESIGN.md 写好了，可以直接用了吗
evals.expected_output: Runs lint_design_md.py and fixes FAIL lines before saying it is done.

evals.prompt: 从 scrape 结果里抽出主色和圆角
evals.expected_output: Uses extract_design_signals.py, not grep -P.

evals.prompt: 覆盖现有 DESIGN.md，换成 Notion 风
evals.expected_output: Warns about existing DESIGN.md; fetch script writes DESIGN.md.bak.
